items.q: Why put an MCP gateway in front of servers?
items.a: **Central auth** (JWT, session in Redis), namespace routing, scoped user tokens and **one place for logs, traces and metrics**; no direct endpoint access.

items.q: What does the dev portal create?
items.a: A repo with LangGraph agent, memory, tracking/eval, **PII-blocking and context-optimizer modules**, plus workload identity, memory DB, eval tables and secrets.
Requests are classified read/modify/delete; reads run, **sensitive writes wait for human approval**; both are audit-logged.

items.q: What does the context optimizer do?
items.a: Selects payload by token budget, reranks, dedupes and compresses; **24k → ~2.4k tokens** in the demo.
